releaseNotesMarkdown:
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mveinot/transmission-control/compare/v2.5.2.455...v2.5.3.467-beta

Beta release - significant reorganization, code cleanup and some refactoring

* Fix tray icon in Linux version so it is visible
* Centralize source components under src/ folder
* Change app license to GPLv3 or later
* Update bundled GeoIP DB
* Clean up build process for test suite
* Enhance event reporting in the activity log: multiple selectable streams for information or warning/error
* Improvements to some build/release related scripts
